description: This Java class 'PersonNameGlobalPropertyListener' implements the 'GlobalPropertyListener' interface to handle changes to the 'Person Name' format configuration for the OpenMRS platform. It reacts specifically to changes in the 'NAME_FORMAT' global property by updating the format used for PersonName objects.

classes.name: PersonNameGlobalPropertyListener
classes.description: A listener class that reacts to changes in the global property for PersonName format.

methods.name: supportsPropertyName
methods.description: Checks if the provided property name matches the configured name for PersonName layout.

methods.name: globalPropertyChanged
methods.description: Updates the PersonName format when the associated global property value changes.

methods.name: globalPropertyDeleted
methods.description: A placeholder method for handling deletion of the global property, currently empty.
